svg.title: Hotel concierge — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as hotel concierge, wearing a work uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A large round-headed guest key with two teeth hangs beside a distinct pointed luggage tag. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
